query:
SELECT COUNT(*) as total, 
       SUM(CASE WHEN ownerWhatsapp IS NOT NULL AND ownerWhatsapp != '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as con_whatsapp,
       SUM(CASE WHEN sourceUrl IS NOT NULL AND sourceUrl != '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as con_url
FROM properties;
